create.name: Mark Horn
create.bio:
Mark Horn is a New York City teacher of Kabbalistic tarot and the author of Tarot and the Gates of Light. He has studied Kabbalah with scholars, rabbis and practitioners, and tarot with many of the field's leading teachers, and he has taught both at the Jewish Theological Seminary and at the Readers Studio tarot conference. Storytelling sits at the heart of his practice: he performs sacred stories and draws on the archetypes in myths from many traditions when he reads for clients, and he has published short fiction on gay spirituality.

His approach treats the Waite-Smith deck as a map of the Kabbalistic Tree of Life, so that each card can be read through its place on the Tree. His book adapts the traditional 49-day practice of Counting the Omer, pairing each day with a card for contemplation. He offers interactive private readings over Zoom that use the cards to draw out a client's own insight rather than to predict, and he teaches online courses and workshops, including an eight-session introduction to Kabbalistic tarot, an intermediate course on the Tree of Life spread, a class on the Omer practice and a short workshop on his Five Worlds spread. He has spoken at tarot conferences and at synagogues and Jewish Renewal gatherings.

books.title: Tarot and the Gates of Light
books.author: Mark Horn
books.description: A workbook that joins the Rider-Waite-Smith deck to the Kabbalistic practice of Counting the Omer, giving a card and a contemplation for each of the 49 days as a path of inner preparation.

courses.title: Kabbalistic Tarot Reading
courses.description: An interactive reading of 45 to 60 minutes over Zoom in which he uses the cards to ask questions that help you reach your own answer, on spiritual or practical matters.

courses.title: Unlocking the Gates of Light: Introduction to Kabbalistic Tarot
courses.description: An eight-session online course in practical Kabbalah through the tarot: how the Waite-Smith deck maps onto the Tree of Life, everyday spreads and practices, and reading on spiritual, psychological, emotional and physical levels at once. No prior Kabbalah needed.

courses.title: Kabbalistically Speaking: How to Read the Tree of Life Spread
courses.description: An intermediate course of eight 90-minute Zoom sessions on reading the Tree of Life spread through traditional Kabbalistic teaching, and using it as a shiviti, a meditative focus.

courses.title: Make Every Day Count: Counting the Omer with Tarot
courses.description: A class teaching the 49-day Omer count as a tarot practice, following the journey from Egypt to Sinai with a card for each day's contemplation.

courses.title: The Five Worlds Reading
courses.description: A short workshop on a five-card spread built on the Kabbalistic teaching of five worlds and five levels of the soul, with time to practise on real questions.
